author: doomdevice666
body: If you’re under T10 it is not worth it imo. It’s more useful for end game stuff. Demon forges can be found around town. I’d say get the tier instead of upgrading.

author: Milsurp_Seeker
body: If you don’t have a DF, I guess? It seems like a luxury imo. I’ve never really felt the need for a coliseum personally.

author: weirdplacetogoonfire
body: Chances are, no, you probably don't need it. I didn't bother upgrading until I ran out of pet slots. The other benefits aren't very meaningful.

author: ewsmith
body: ~~that orn cost is the same as a t10 class.~~ t10 are actually 15m... i'd wait until you've unlocked at least one first.

author: petr1petr
body:
nope - not needed

DF are not rare - they are everywhere

colliseum - "one day, it will rotate again" - so not needed

plus it is really huge - I avoid it all I can - my neighbor built one and afaik never used what it offered

author: subtxtcan
body: Hopping in here as I'm just into T7 and had this question... Seems like a pretty solid consensus... Looks like that 300m gold I have is going to other things for now

author: silenced_rainbow
body: Shortly yes, unless you have other priorities for the resources

author: Tavmania
body:
I haven't done it yet and I don't miss it because there's a demonforge at work. 

For reference: level 250 Heretic, 25 ascension levels.

author: SucculentApprentice
body: It’s not nearly as important as the dungeon upgrade. I’d recommend prioritising orns on classes until 10 mil orns isn’t a big deal. It gives a demonforge and unlimited pet storage

author: dobbyjhin
body: Would you get more gold cause of the increase storage and by how much?

author: rocksoffjagger
body: I only upgraded at like level 230+ when I reached the limit of pets for the fortress. Well worth it for the increased pet storage once that becomes relevant, but not worth it below t10

author: Kelyrrlith
body:
Itass a free demonforge & more gold as well as follower storage.
If thats what you desire, yes. But i would first buy all classes, you can always demonforge via wayvessel.

author: Scelusteach
body: I did it at t9. But I was still fresh in t9 and still unaware of a lot in orna back then. I can say I had enough orns when I hit t10

author: Environmental_Boot17
body: No. It just stores more gold per lvl

author: bracarensis
body: I don't regret upgrading mine. Never seen a demonforge in my area. Lvl 238 ascension 12 Heretic.

author: Dear_Madelene
body: I'm surprised about answers here! I'd say it worth it of you can afford it. I use my alchemist, demonforge and coliseum all the time, much more convenient to do everything from home than having to wait all the time to do everything at once.

author: Maudeth
body:
Short answer- yes.

Long answer- depends on where you're at, tier and orn wise. I have one on my t6 alt. Well worth it.
